servinfo.title: Warning for Radar Brake Support System

item.ptxt: Failure to take the following precautions may cause a serious accident affected by malfunction of RBS system.
For K10C model and K12C model, do not affix sticker including clear film over the millimeter wave radar cover located in front of the RBS control module.
For K14C model, do not affix sticker including clear film to front surface of the RBS control module.
Do not drop or otherwise expose RBS control module to large shock. The RBS control module that has received large shock should be replaced.
When replacing front bumper, radiator grill and millimeter wave radar cover (K10C model / K12C model), use SUZUKI genuine parts.
Do not modify suspension. Modification of the vehicle’s height or inclination may affect correct detection of a running vehicle ahead.
Use tires of the same size and brand. Do not mix tires of different wear.
Driving a vehicle which might have been exposed to impact at around front bumper i.e. the vehicle involved in an accident, automatic brake could work suddenly and could cause a serious accident.
When driving such a vehicle, disable RBS system by pushing the RBS OFF switch or ESP® OFF switch for a long time to turn on RBS OFF light beforehand.

attention3.ptxt: When vehicle is hoisted and wheels are rotated with engine running, disable RBS system beforehand. If not, RBS could work unexpectedly.
